seoTitle: Noise Texture Generator: Tileable Grain as Transparent PNG
metaDescription: Make a seamless grain or noise PNG with density, opacity and tint to overlay on gradients and flat colours. Free, local.
intro: Creates a square transparent PNG filled with random grain, colour noise or sparse speckles that tiles without seams.
why:
A touch of grain makes gradients look richer and hides banding. Every pixel here is random and independent, so the tile repeats without a visible edge. Opacity controls how strong the overlay is, density how many pixels are filled.

The seed makes a result repeatable. Use the PNG as a CSS background over a colour or gradient. Large tiles and high opacity increase file size.
howTo: Choose the tile size and noise type.
Run it and preview the tile.
Download the PNG and use it as a repeating background.

faq.a: Yes. Pixels are independent, so there is no pattern to break at the edges.
